title: I have come into the world as light

request.style: English, male baritone, solo voice, acoustic piano, cello, soft strings, ambient pads, 70 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
For they loved human glory more
Than the glory of God
Then Jesus cried out
Whoever believes in me
Does not believe in me
But in him who sent me

[Chorus]
I have come into the world as light
So that no one who believes in me
Should remain in darkness

[Verse]
And if anyone hears my words
And does not keep them
I do not judge him
For I did not come to judge the world
But to save the world

[Chorus]
I have come into the world as light
So that no one who believes in me
Should remain in darkness

[Bridge]
Whoever rejects me
And does not receive my words
Already has a judge
The very word I have spoken
Will judge him on the last day

[Chorus]
I have come into the world as light
So that no one who believes in me
Should remain in darkness

[Outro]
I have not spoken on my own authority
The Father has commanded me
